paragraphs.text: Chennifer , the Meet and Greet " Sisay " , is an elf performer who is part of Myra the Magnificent's Intergalactic Astrotorium of Fun .

Chennifer is an elven impersonator of Sisay. She plays the role so well that Myra has her play it whenever possible. Though Sisay was not an elf, she was human, the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria was so long ago that the details have been lost in the transition and people look past it because of Chennifer's stellar performance.
